1467 CR 4820
Kempner, TX 76539
$463,000, 4 bed, 2.00 bath, 2,119 SF, MLS# 606206

Looking for a place in the country with some land? Well, this property may be what you are looking for!
This beautiful 4BR and 2BA home in Kempner is on 2.06 acres with a private gated drive. The back section of the property is fenced off and once held horses. 
Entering into the home you will pass through a large foyer and into the spacious family room.  Your dream kitchen boasts granite countertops, a pantry, and an enormous breakfast bar. The kitchen is open to the family room and the dining room. A flex room is located next to the foyer, and can be used as an extra living area, office, dining, or a bedroom.  The enclosed patio is currently being used as a “karaoke” room. 
The bedrooms are all generous in size. The master ensuite has two separate vanities, a large shower, and a good sized closet. This home is located in the Lampasas Independent School District.
Call your favorite realtor today to see this home!

2 full bath
